QUOTE: "**Combined codes.** A single return can carry both parts, for example an SSL code plus a low-level cause. The output is `"HIGH : LOW"`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains the high-level (module, bits 7–15) and low-level (low 7 bits) layers and says mbedtls_strerror joins both with " : " when both are present.
